text: Outside of your family, is there at least one adult in your school, neighborhood or community who knows you well and who you can rely on for advice or guidance?
source: Adapted to youth self-report from NSCH 2024 item K9Q96 (parent report)
terms_note: U.S. government survey item (public domain); wording adapted

text: How many adults outside your family could you go to for advice about school or your future?

How comfortable would you feel asking an adult you don't know well (for example, a teacher, coach or someone at a workplace) for advice or help?
